project_type: FIND-U microservices (Spring Boot Java 21) + Flutter provider app. Backend in a git worktree; mobile app is a separate git repo.
language: Java 21 (Spring Boot 3.4.2) for backend; Dart/Flutter for mobile.
build_system: Gradle wrapper per micro (gradlew.bat on Windows). Flutter toolchain for mobile. QUIRK: security micro is at SECURITY/findu-spring-security (NOT CORE/ as the task prompt said). findu-movil root is NOT a git repo; apps/findu_proveedores is its own git repo on 'master'; findu-movil/packages/* are OUTSIDE that repo and UNVERSIONED.
test_framework: JUnit 5 + Mockito + reactor-test StepVerifier (security, help-v2, notification-processor have src/test). flutter test (pure-Dart unit tests only; NEVER run on device).
build_command: Per backend micro from its worktree dir: .\gradlew.bat build  (e.g. cd SECURITY/findu-spring-security && .\gradlew.bat build). Mobile: flutter analyze  (and flutter test if tests exist) in findu-movil/apps/findu_proveedores.
test_command: .\gradlew.bat test per micro; flutter test for mobile. Seed script syntax: bash -n src/main/resources/db/dynamodb/seed-templates.sh (no AWS execution).
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: build the touched backend micro(s) with .\gradlew.bat build from the worktree dir and run .\gradlew.bat test; for mobile run flutter analyze (no new errors) + flutter test if tests present. Validate the DynamoDB seed with bash -n. Record exact commands + results in each FEAT's findings so the reviewer need not re-run. Do NOT deploy to Railway and do NOT write to real AWS.
environment_constraints: Do NOT change spring.sql.init.mode (qa must stay 'never'); schema.sql begins with DROP and is manual-only. Deliver activation DDL as additive/idempotent (ALTER ... IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) plus a standalone scripts/migrations/V2__provider_activation.sql. Do NOT deploy to Railway or write to real AWS. Mobile: never run on a device/emulator; analyze/test only. Keep Mono/Flux reactive + hexagonal + Lombok. Idempotent consumers/guards. Touch findu-core only for the one write-once photo change.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING present. Follow existing hexagonal layout (domain.model / infrastructure.entity|repository|adapter / application.port.output|usecase(.impl) / presentation.controller in security; domain / application.port|service / infrastructure.adapter.input|out in help-v2 and notification-processor). Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Security triggers notifications via NotificationPort.send(type,recipient,templateCode,language,params) -> NotificationLambdaAdapter POST {findu.notification.lambda-url}/dispatchNotification; security never binds RabbitMQ. Dispatcher presence branch recognizes only PROVEEDOR_/CLIENTE_ recipients and hard-codes EventType.OFFER_RECEIVED, so the mobile client must branch on payload['templateCode']. Authorization resolves operations by EXACT path equality, so new endpoints use STATIC paths (userId in body for approve/reject). Role/operation seed: ops 1-17 exist, add 18-21 (module_id=3) granted role 4 (18,19) + role 5 (20,21). add_soporte.sql at the security micro ROOT seeds role 5 + soporte user. DynamoDB template attribute names must match NotificationTemplateItem constants; ALERTA fields live under alert_meta (titulo, not top-level title). Alert read uses by-code findActive(code,ALERTA,lang) GetItem (GSI_pantalla not wired in Java). help-v2 CreateTicketService uses domain.valueobject.TicketRequester; persistence = HelpTicketDocument + SpringDataHelpTicketRepository(MongoRepository) + HelpTicketMongoMapper + MongoHelpTicketRepository. Mobile uses MaterialApp home: (NO named routes/GoRouter); realtime via network_ws Stream<Map> broadcast (see market_api_adapter.dart); RestHttpClient base = Environment.gatewayUrl with JWT header pattern in profile_api_adapter.dart.
directory_structure: Backend worktree: findu/.worktrees/provider-activation with SECURITY/findu-spring-security, CORE/findu-core, CORE/findu-help-v2, CORE/findu-notification-processor, CORE/LAMBDA/findu-notification-dispatcher (unchanged). Mobile: findu-movil/apps/findu_proveedores (own git repo, master) with lib/features/{auth_onboarding,profile,market,...}/{domain,application,infrastructure,presentation}; shared findu-movil/packages/* (network_rest, network_ws, ui_kit, ...) are unversioned.
